info.title: Marketplace
info.description: Customer-facing API for the Noon Marketplace platform (UAE storefront). Base path: /api/customer/v1/{country}. All requests in this collection target the 'ae' (UAE) country code. Authenticated endpoints require a Bearer token obtained via /auth/login or /auth/register.

get.description: Composite home page endpoint. Returns the CMS-driven page builder blocks (banners, carousels, curated collections) plus computed sections and meta. Public, no authentication required.
Returns the unified navigation menu tree (categories with children) used to render the storefront header/sidebar. Public, cached.
Browse the product catalog with filters, sorting and pagination. Public endpoint backing the generic products listing (distinct from the category-scoped /browse endpoint).
Full product detail page including all vendor listings (buy box / best offer first). {{:slug}} is the product's SEO slug.
Full-text search across active listings with filters and facets. Requires the `q` parameter.
Autocomplete suggestions for a partial search term, used to populate the search-bar dropdown.
All active travel packages, unfiltered (equivalent to /browse/travel/all). Public.
Public list of approved customer reviews for a product, paginated.
Returns the full category tree used for category navigation/filtering. Public.
Legacy alias retained for backwards compatibility with old category URLs. Always issues a 301 redirect to the equivalent /browse/product/{slug} endpoint.

Unified browse endpoint for a product category page. {{type}} in the route can be `product`, `classified` or `travel`; this example uses `product`. Returns the category metadata, CMS page-builder blocks for the category, and paginated listings.
Unified browse endpoint used for classifieds category pages (e.g. cars, real estate). Same shape as the product variant but `listings.items` contain classified_card objects.
Unified browse endpoint used for travel package category pages.
Vendor storefront page: vendor profile, CMS page-builder blocks configured by the vendor, and their active listings.
Brand landing page with CMS blocks and all active listings for that brand.
Generic CMS page renderer for static content pages (about-us, terms, faq, etc). {{type}} is the page key.
Unified listing detail endpoint. {{type}} in the route is `product`, `classified` or `travel`. For `product`, {{slug}} is the product's SEO slug.
Classified listing detail. {{slug}} is the classified listing_number (e.g. CL-10432). Includes seller contact info.
Travel package detail. {{slug}} is the package UUID.

package.description: All-inclusive overwater villa package with return flights.

post.description: Send an inquiry message to the seller of a classified listing. Requires authentication.
Create a booking request for a travel package. Requires authentication. Booking starts in `pending_documents` status until the contract is signed via the /contract endpoint.

example.message: No seats available for the requested number of travelers

post.description: Submit the signed contract/consent for a pending travel booking, moving it from `pending_documents` to `confirmed`. Requires authentication.

post.description: Create a new customer account. Rate-limited to 10 requests/minute per IP.

example.message: The email has already been taken.

email: The email has already been taken.

post.description: Authenticate with email/password and receive a JWT bearer token. Rate-limited to 10 requests/minute per IP.
Exchange a valid (non-expired) JWT for a fresh one. Rate-limited to 10 requests/minute per IP.
Request a password-reset email. Rate-limited to 5 requests/minute per IP. Always returns 200 regardless of whether the email exists, to avoid account enumeration.

example.message: If that email exists, a reset link has been sent.
The email field must be a valid email address.

post.description: Complete a password reset using the token from the forgot-password email. Rate-limited to 5 requests/minute per IP.

post.description: Verify a customer's email address using the token from the verification email link. No auth guard — the token itself authorizes the action.

example.message: This verification link is invalid or has expired.
